data.desc: FreeCast, Inc. (NASDAQ: CAST) is a technology company providing streaming entertainment solutions and enterprise Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) technology. FreeCast enables telecommunications companies, internet service providers, wireless operators, satellite providers, and other organizations to offer branded streaming entertainment experiences to their existing customers through a white-label software platform. The company's technology integrates live television, streaming content discovery, subscription management, advertising monetization, and commerce across multiple devices and distribution environments. Through its SmartGuide, YouBundle, MediaPay, and Zer0Gap Ads technologies, FreeCast seeks to simplify the fragmented streaming marketplace while creating new opportunities for enterprise partners, content providers, and advertisers.
